_comment: The widening the injected page asks for, aimed across a host boundary.
auth_disabled is not in the goal, so it is not in what the reader holds, so this
delegation is wider than the delegator's own set and host A's capability authority
refuses to make it. The message is never handed to the federation proxy at all --
the widened capability does not reach the network, let alone the other host.
Rung 5a runs the same record a second way, from an ENROLLED but misbehaving sender
that skips host A's relay entirely and puts this claim straight into a federation
envelope. That path is refused on host B instead, by the receiving proxy, because
auth_disabled is outside the ops SERVICE's deploy-time role. Two independent
ceilings, one on each side of the network, and the demo asserts them separately
because they fail for different reasons in different places.
